payload.caption: Overhead view of an urban area containing a central compound with a distinctive circular track network and surrounding high-density residential developments.
payload.description: The frame shows an open central facility enclosed within a dense urban landscape characterized by high-rise residential blocks and an orthogonal road grid. Within the central compound, a prominent circular road network features symmetric radial loops, inner paths, and drive-through style pads or revetment outlines arranged around a linear central axis. South of this circular pattern are several low-rise rectangular structures, open paved courtyards, and multiple small rectangular objects (possibly vehicles or small utility structures) parked in orderly rows. A diagonal linear track corridor borders the north-eastern edge of the inner compound.

features.note: Large outer ring road containing inner radial pathways and symmetrical lobes/pads.
Low-rise buildings positioned south of the circular layout.
Rows of small dark rectangular objects situated along access tracks south of the circular loop.
Paved multi-lane roads surrounding the site boundary.

payload.gsd_note: Resolution sufficient to resolve road networks, building footprints, and small vehicle-sized objects.
